# Amnesty International

> > Global human rights organization documenting violations, running campaigns, and providing educational resources across Eastern Europe, Central Asia, the Middle East, and worldwide.

Amnesty International operates regional hubs and campaigns addressing issues including surveillance technology, LGBTI rights, Ukraine conflict, and humanitarian crises. The organization provides human rights education through Amnesty Academy and maintains internal systems like ADAM for asset management.

## Key Topics

- Human Rights
- Eastern Europe and Central Asia
- Ukraine Conflict
- LGBTI Rights
- Middle East
- International Law
- Humanitarian Crisis
- Facial Recognition Surveillance
- Israel
- Lebanon
- USA
- Iran
- Russia
- International Secretariat

## Regional Hubs

- [Amnesty International в Восточной Европе и Центральной Азии](https://eurasia.amnesty.org/): Amnesty International regional hub for Eastern Europe and Central Asia

## Campaigns and Advocacy

- [Ban the Scan](https://banthescan.amnesty.org/): Campaign against facial recognition surveillance by NYPD and globally

## Education and Training

- [Amnesty Academy Registration](https://register.academy.amnesty.org/): Registration portal for Amnesty Academy's free human rights courses

## Internal Systems and Support

- [Login to ADAM](https://adam.amnesty.org/): ADAM asset bank login portal with Microsoft365/Office365 SSO authentication
